lines.text: Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
Remember the briefness of my lifespan!
For what futility You have created all men!
What man can live and never see death?
Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?
Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old,
which You faithfully swore to David?
Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants,
which I bear in my heart from so many people—
how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD,
and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!

pictures.scene: Isaac Levitan, Vladimirka — the long empty road that the prisoners walked, running away over the grey land to nothing, how long, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_levitan_hoelang

pictures.scene: Hubert Robert, Incendie à Rome — the fire taking the whole street at night with the people running out of it, will You hide Yourself forever, will Your wrath keep burning like fire
pictures.name: pd_robert_vuur

pictures.scene: Jean-Baptiste-Siméon Chardin, Soap Bubbles — the boy leaning out of the window blowing one bubble that will last a few seconds more, remember the briefness of my lifespan, for what futility You have created all men
pictures.name: pd_chardin_vluchtig

pictures.scene: Arnold Böcklin, Die Toteninsel — the small boat rowing the white figure across the still water to the island of the dead, what man can live and never see death, can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol
pictures.name: pd_bocklin_dood

pictures.scene: Carl Friedrich Lessing, Klosterhof im Schnee — the old cloister standing in the snow with the arches it has kept open for hundreds of winters, where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old
pictures.name: pd_lessing_vanouds

pictures.scene: Honoré Daumier, The Third-Class Carriage — the poor sitting patiently along the bench of the cheapest carriage with their baskets on their knees, which You faithfully swore to David, remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants
pictures.name: pd_daumier_smaad

pictures.scene: Vasily Surikov, Boyarynya Morozova — the woman carried off in chains through the snow with her hand raised over the jeering crowd, which I bear in my heart from so many people, how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD
pictures.name: pd_surikov_gehoond

pictures.scene: Hans Thoma, Kinderreigen — the children holding hands in a ring in the flowering meadow and singing as they turn, blessed be the LORD forever
pictures.name: pd_thoma_gezegend

pictures.scene: Gari Melchers, In Church — the women sitting still in their pew with the Bible held on the lap and every face turned up to listen, amen and amen
pictures.name: pd_melchers_amen
